sourceEvidence.read: STRIVE2013 indexed original microbleed/lacune definitions, sequence-dependent apparent size and mimics.
Norman1977 original complete in-vitro abstract: concentration/haemoconcentration dependence. Does not establish universal50–80HU threshold; that range is explicitly PDF example.
Selariu2012 actual definition/methods and subacute peripheral-resorption mimic; clinical-outcome scope separated from expansion.
Ng2018 original methods, serial-volume results and discussion/selection bias,212 included cases; supports association not individual certainty.
Wada2007 original abstract methods and outcomes through indexed original abstract/reprint; no claim publisher fulltext read. Spot association is imperfect, not guaranteed expansion.
Gomori1985 complete original20-haematoma1.5T abstract; typical evolution/field dependence, no rigid time-clock endorsed.
Gomori1988 complete original5-case abstract; intracellular versus undiluted/dilute extracellular metHb and mimics.
AHA2022 official indexed recommendation passages for rapidCT/MRI, selected acuteCTA±venography, MRI/MRA after negativeCTA, selectedDSA; bounded diagnostic sections, not whole guideline.
Kidwell2004 original abstract results and indexed publisher hyperacute example caption; acute detection comparison and old microbleed sensitivity, not all-phase MRI superiority.
DIAGRAM2015 original indexed abstract, diagnostic procedures and results; complementaryCTA/MRI/selectedDSA, no universal followup interval introduced.

Boston2.0 original indexed findings and Table2 criteria: age/context, strictly lobar lesions/cSS, absence of deep haemorrhagic lesions and other causes. Direct open CAPTCHA; indexed original text read instead.

Hartmann2001 complete original17-patient abstract and figure captions: restricted diffusion characteristic but not pathognomonic; tumour exceptions. Intralesional-haemorrhage cases excluded, no hematoma-specific performance claim inferred.
